name: - OverNight
fix_description: In _totalValue, the vault value is calculated using platypusLPUsdc.liability() which can be manipulated by creating a fake trader pool with a new token. Fix: validate liability against an independent oracle or TWAP, do not trust raw liability from the LP token when it can be influenced by unwhitelisted pools.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC chains multiple protocols and primitives: nested flash loans across Aave V2/V3, Benqi collateral/borrowing, repeated StableSwap liquidity imbalance operations, USD+ buy/redeem timing constraints across blocks, and final settlement through Platypus/Sicle. Understanding and reproducing the exploit requires deep protocol-specific reasoning about accounting/state changes and a fairly long multi-step attack flow, well beyond a straightforward single-pattern exploit.
